verdicts.reason: A keeps the Inkwell & Lantern logo legible and the headline dominant, but the card bleeds off the top, bottom and right edges, and the '24 HOURS, 24 READERS' eyebrow is cut off from the headline and parked under the logo. The legal text beside the CTA is also microscopic. B keeps the eyebrow above the headline and the floating card over confetti, which is truer to the original, but the logo is shrunk to an illegible speck in the corner, a brand failure. Its CTA is also small and cramped next to tiny legal text.
